envelope.description: Show each document of an artifact in its own tab, HTML artifacts as the full page

body.title: Show each document of an artifact in its own tab, HTML artifacts as the full page
body.summary: The header shows one tab per document: the markdown first, then each HTML artifact by title. Choosing an HTML tab asks the host for the file and sets its text as the srcdoc of a frame with sandbox allow-scripts, with the file's path shown above it. Comments made on an HTML tab are whole-document comments with that file as their target.
acceptanceChecks: Each HTML artifact has its own tab, and choosing it posts open-companion
The frame is set from the posted text with sandbox allow-scripts and nothing else; without text the tab shows the path and a line
A comment sent from an HTML tab names that file and carries no anchor

tests.name: docs review shell: an HTML document's tab posts open-companion, and docs-companion sets the text as the srcdoc of a frame with sandbox allow-scripts and shows the file's path; with no html it shows the path and a line of text
docs review shell: there is one tab per document, the markdown first, and a comment sent from an HTML tab names that file and has no anchor
